headline: September 1, 2026 state primary election results, post-election audit reports, and voting machine testing.
summary: Ballot totals, voter check-ins, and any discrepancies from the September 1 state primary will be reviewed, along with state post-election audit reports. Voting machine testing, inactive voters, and the Sullivan and Vacon orders are also on the agenda.
items: Review of September 1, 2026 state primary election results
Review of ballot totals, voter check-ins, and discrepancies from the primary
Review of Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth post-election audit reports
Review of voting equipment testing requirements and procedures
Vacon Order on the November 2025 election
plain_text:
CITY OF HOLYOKE 
BOARD OF REGISTRARS OF VOTERS 
MEETING AGENDA 
Thursday, October 15, 2026 
4:00 PM 
City Hall 
 
1. Sullivan Order – Voter Turnout 
2. Inactive Voters-Update 
3. Review of September 1, 2026 State Primary Election Results and Secretary of 
the Commonwealth Post-Election Audit Reports 
 Review of the September 1, 2026 State Primary Election results. 
 Discussion of ballot totals, voter check-ins, and any discrepancies identified during the 
election. 
 Review of post-election audit reports issued by the Massachusetts Secretary of the 
Commonwealth. 
4. Voting Machine Testing 
 Review of voting equipment testing requirements and procedures. 
5. Vacon Order – November 2025 Election 
6. Adjournment 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
Brenna Murphy Leary, MMC 
City Clerk, Holyoke Massachusetts
